FANTASTIC FOOD & STAFF!!
Jul 2026 • Family
Korean BBQ is always hit or miss for me because I never know if I’m cooking it right, meat gets stuck in the grates, ugh. This was not that experience at all. Our waiter Khai was the best. He cooked everything for us (including garlic, mushrooms, and pineapple which the kids love). Then he showed us how to use the sides and condiments, what to eat together, how to make wraps from sesame leaves. Everything was fresh and delicious. And Khai ended the night with candy for the kids and mango soft serve. It was a delicious and fun experience. Highly recommend!
